response.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), overall AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, CAST(s.artifact_count AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(o.artifact_total, 0) AS share FROM site_totals AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
